title: ✨ A Birthday Prayer for Maria Nilma Olam Hoysted ✨
paragraphs:
✨ A Birthday Prayer for Maria Nilma Olam Hoysted ✨
Today, we celebrate not just another year — but God’s goodness, mercy, and the unstoppable purpose He placed inside her life.
May this new chapter overflow with grace, divine favor, peace, and doors only God can open.
May your steps be guided, your heart be protected, and your joy be full.
Happy Blessed Birthday, Maria Nilma! 🙏💛
May God continue writing a story in you that inspires generations.

“The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make His face shine upon you and be gracious to you.”
– Numbers 6:24–25
